company.shortDescription: UiPath is a software company that designs and develops robotic process automation and artificial intelligence applications.
company.description: UiPath designs and develops robotic process automation software. The platform offers foolproof development tools, automation of intricate processes, enhanced control, cloud and on-premise deployment, robust governance, and multiple robots on a single virtual machine. It is a company that specializes in the creation of intelligent, business processes, and robotic software.

aiResearchSummary.text: UiPath is researching advanced robotic process automation and artificial intelligence for designing, executing and optimizing workflows. Work such as Automatic activation and configuration of robotic process automation workflows, Semantic target identification for user interface automation, Assisted task mining using large language models, Artificial intelligence-based process identification, extraction, and automation, and Agentic orchestration shows focus on AI-driven workflow design, task and process mining, resilient UI automation, and coordinated AI agent and robot operations.
